## History

Early in her life, Emily worked as a schoolteacher before marrying Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md). She previously left her husband after a quarrel over his parrot, [Ginger](../character/ginger.md), returning to her own home and vowing to remain there until he got rid of the bird. After their period of separation, Emily arrived at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) looking for her husband, leading to a full reconciliation with Mr.

_Sources: [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P1](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0001), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P2](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0002), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P3](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0003), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P4](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0004), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P5](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0005), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P6](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0006), +65 more_

## Quotes

> — Emily — [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P61](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0061)

> "Well, I did think this place seemed too tidy . . . much too tidy for James A. to be living here, unless he has greatly changed since I knew him"
>
> — Emily — [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P12](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0012)

> "A friend sent a marked copy to me . . . friends are always so ready to do such things. James A.‘s name was written in over ‘new citizen.’"

## Relationships

### [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/emily--harrison.md)

Emily is the wife of Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), from whom she was previously separated due to a dispute over his pet parrot, [Ginger](../character/ginger.md). Her sudden arrival in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) seeking her husband initially shocked the local neighborhood. However, the couple has since reconciled, with Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) cleaning his home in preparation for her return.

- Spouse of — married couple who reconciled (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P47](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0047), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P9](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0009), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P2](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0002)</sub>

### [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/emily--rachel-lynde.md)

Emily and [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) are neighbors and shopping companions in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). Upon Emily's arrival in town, Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) actively investigated the gossip surrounding her past separation from Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md). Despite the initial neighborhood scrutiny, the two women share a friendly connection.

- Friend of — neighbors and shopping companions (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P47](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0047), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P5](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0005)</sub>
